title: PCSK9 inhibitor for hyperlipidemia (e.g., evolocumab)
note: Synthetic, simplified policy for research use. Modeled on common criteria patterns; not any real insurer's policy and not clinical guidance. Held out from verifier training to test generalization.

criteria.text: Patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease or heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia.

params.condition: atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease or heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia

criteria.text: Patient is 18 years of age or older.
Most recent LDL-C is 70 mg/dL or higher, measured within the last 120 days.
Patient has tried a high-intensity statin (atorvastatin or rosuvastatin) for at least 90 days.
Adherence to statin therapy is documented.
